_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::pasi#1, and a falsification of its Signal. Switching INTERACTION from DEM to SPH on upstream pasi_twoway_norelax_particle_dem_1d_normalcontact_linspring_walldiscretcond.4C.yaml while leaving MAT_ParticleDEM, MAT_ParticleWallDEM and the PARTICLE DYNAMIC/DEM section in place — exactly the mismatch the entry describes — gives neither 'interaction type mismatch' nor silent zero-force coupling. 4C prints its time-stepping banner and then takes Signal: Segmentation fault (11) / Address not mapped (1) with no PROC 0 ERROR block, no message, no MPI_Abort banner, and exit status 139 rather than 1. The run never reaches a result test, so there is no zero-force output to inspect. An agent watching for a diagnostic gets a bare crash. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: leave INTERACTION at DEM in the second arm. The interaction model then matches its materials, the segmentation fault vanishes and EXIT_MISMATCH becomes 0, so the fixture must go red.
